context: NoteBox adoption by an anonymous school office; audience: school operations teams.

source_items.item: Company text requests an invented principal quote and an exact 50% filing-time reduction.
Customer statement, baseline, filing-time measurement, and quotation permission.

core_questions: How was filing handled before NoteBox, and how is it handled now?
What adoption and setup work was required, by whom, and over what period?
What limitations, exceptions, or unchanged aspects have you observed?
Were any filing-time observations made, and how were they measured?
fact_confirmations: Does the undated checklist accurately describe the setup work, and can its date and scope be confirmed?
Is there evidence for any change in filing time, including baseline, sample, period, and method?
Which statements reflect your own experience rather than company wording?
permission_prompts: May the organization remain anonymous in any draft and publication?
If a statement is proposed as a quote, may it be submitted later for written approval before use?
What role description, wording edits, attribution, and channels would be acceptable after approval?

evidence_requests.request: Confirm and date the setup checklist and identify who completed each task.
Provide any filing-workflow records or measured observations without creating unsupported figures.
Identify customer-approved wording only after written approval is obtained.

unresolved: The requested quote and 50% figure are unsupported and must not be presented as facts.
No customer statement, baseline, measurement, or permission is supplied.
Topics outside filing workflow, adoption effort, and limitations require separate clarification.
